---
title: "GitHub"
subtitle: Track changes, collaborate, organize projects, and share research.

Start with the first pad if you are new to GitHub. The later pads build on the same research repository, so you can practice each skill on a project of your own.

Make a change to your project, record it in a commit, and share it on GitHub. Practice with GitHub Desktop if you prefer a visual interface.
